jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer – AI Applications & OpenShift
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced Full-Stack Engineer who enjoys building secure, scalable backend solutions and integrating modern AI capabilities into enterprise applications?  
Do you thrive in collaborative environments where you can work with real-time data, cloud-native technologies, and cross-functional teams to deliver reliable, business-critical solutions?  
Ready  to   grow   your   career   with  a  global  AI  and  cloud leader,  working  on  innovative   technologies   that  make a real impact  across   industries   and   markets ?  

Practical Information 

Location:  Riyadh,  Saudi Arabia  
| Work Arrangement:  Hybrid
  |  Reports to:  Service Line Delivery Lead  
|  Contract type:  Full-time  
|  Visa Requirements:  Valid Visa for  KSA  
| Language Requirements:  Fluent /professional   English ,  written and verbal , Arabic is a strong plus

We are looking for a  Senior Full-Stack Engineer
 with strong  expertise  in backend development, systems integration, and application deployment to help build and enhance enterprise AI-enabled solutions within a secure industrial environment. In this role, you will focus on developing robust backend services and APIs, enabling real-time data integration, ensuring application reliability, and supporting containerized deployments and production readiness. The ideal candidate is comfortable working with modern web architectures, enterprise integrations, AI/ML services, and container platforms such as  OpenShift
 and  Kubernetes
.  

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and  maintain  secure backend services and APIs for enterprise web applications  
Build and enhance application services for reporting, dashboards, notifications, user workflows, administrative functions, and AI-enabled capabilities  
Integrate applications with enterprise data sources, operational platforms, document repositories, notification services, and existing backend systems  
Develop and support real-time or near-real-time data flows using  APIs,  WebSockets , Server-Sent Events
, message queues, and similar integration patterns  
Collaborate with AI and data teams to integrate model outputs, analytics services, RAG/LLM capabilities, and monitoring components into application workflows  
Support containerized deployments using  Docker 
and  OpenShift/Kubernetes
,  leveraging   Bitbucket/Git, CI/CD pipelines
, release management, environment configuration, and deployment validation  
Ensure application reliability, security, and operational readiness through troubleshooting, logging, monitoring, performance optimization, patch releases, secure coding practices, testing, documentation, and close collaboration with architects, frontend engineers, DevOps, cybersecurity teams, and business stakeholders  

Job Requirements
Extensive experience in full-stack or backend-focused enterprise application development, with strong  expertise  in designing and building scalable backend services using technologies such as  Node.js, Java/Spring Boot, Python/ FastAPI /Django
, or similar frameworks  
Strong experience designing, developing, and documenting  RESTful APIs
, including secure API design, authentication, authorization, role-based access control, and enterprise integration patterns  
Hands-on experience with relational and NoSQL databases, including  PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis,  TimescaleDB
, or similar technologies  
Experience deploying and operating applications in containerized environments using  Docker
 and  OpenShift/Kubernetes
, supported by a solid understanding of  CI/CD pipelines, Git/Bitbucket workflows, code reviews, branching strategies, and release processes

Proven ability to troubleshoot production issues, performance bottlenecks, integration failures, and application reliability challenges in complex enterprise environments  
Strong understanding of application security, vulnerability remediation, and secure software development practices  
Ability to work effectively in structured enterprise environments, following established processes for documentation, testing, quality assurance, and formal acceptance procedures  

What  we  offer

Our company benefits vary based on your location, but always include:   
Global company culture: We defined our 6 core values through our company culture ( https://www.softwareone.com/en/our-story/our-values )  
A mentor who supports your successful start and is at your side with advice and action  
President’s Club: Recognition awarded by leadership and your peers  
Lifelong education: A variety of training and development opportunities  
Hire to Grow: We  optimize  our internal structures and feedback culture constantly to be your Employer of Choice, today and in future  

Company description

SoftwareOne is a global provider of software and cloud solutions. With a presence in over 70 countries and more than 12,000 professionals, we help organizations optimize software investments, modernize applications, and unlock the value of cloud, data, and AI.

Our people are at the core of everything we do. We enable collaboration across borders, continuous learning, and opportunities to grow in a fast-evolving technology landscape. Whether your focus is on technology, customer success, or business operations, your ideas matter, and your contributions make a difference.

Join a global team where you can build your skills, work with leading technologies, and make a real impact for our customers.

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer
jobs.description:
Established in 2004, Indus Real Estate LLC is a RERA-registered real estate company with over two decades of experience in Dubai’s property market. We work with local and international clients across sales, leasing, and investment advisory.

Why Join Us

At Indus Real Estate, technology plays an important role in delivering exceptional real estate experiences. You will have the opportunity to build innovative digital solutions, improve business processes, and collaborate with experienced professionals while contributing to the company's continued growth.

Indus Real Estate is looking for a Full Stack Developer with experience in the Dubai real estate industry to join our team. In this full-time, on-site role, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining websites, CRM systems, and internal applications while supporting digital initiatives across our Sales, Leasing, Off-Plan, and Marketing teams.

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, test, and maintain responsive websites, web applications, and internal business systems.
Build and maintain front-end interfaces, back-end services, and secure RESTful APIs.
Develop and support integrations with CRM systems, property portals (such as Property Finder, Bayut, and Dubizzle), and other third-party platforms.
Maintain and optimize databases while ensuring data accuracy, security, and system performance.
Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve technical issues to ensure application reliability.
Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, and Operations teams to gather requirements and deliver scalable digital solutions.
Support website enhancements, landing pages, CRM improvements, and automation of business workflows.
Write clean, scalable, and well-documented code following industry best practices.
Participate in testing, deployment, code reviews, and ongoing system maintenance.
Stay updated with emerging technologies and recommend improvements to enhance business efficiency and user experience.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or any related IT field.
Minimum 2–3 years of experience as a Full Stack Developer, preferably within the Dubai real estate industry, PropTech company, or real estate brokerage.
Experience developing and maintaining real estate websites, CRM systems, or property management platforms.
Proficiency in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and modern front-end frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.js.
Experience with back-end technologies such as Node.js, Laravel (PHP), .NET, or Python.
Strong knowledge of SQL databases and RESTful API development.
Experience integrating with Property Finder, Bayut, Dubizzle, or similar real estate platforms is an advantage.
Strong problem-solving, communication, and teamwork skills.

What We Offer

Competitive salary package based on experience and qualifications.
Opportunity to work on impactful digital transformation and PropTech initiatives.
Collaborative and supportive work environment.
Career growth and continuous learning opportunities.
Access to corporate employee discount programs and partner offers, where applicable.
Opportunity to contribute to one of Dubai's established real estate companies with over 20 years of industry experience.

How to Apply

Interested candidates may send their CVs to careers@indusre.ae or message us directly on LinkedIn.

Service You Deserve. People You Trust.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description:
At Cision, we believe in empowering every individual to make an impact. Here, your voice is heard, your ideas are valued, and your unique perspective fuels our collective success. As part of our global team, you'll thrive in an environment that champions curiosity, collaboration, and innovation, all while making meaningful contributions to the brands we accelerate.

Join us in shaping the future of communication and building authentic connections that matter. Whether you're solving complex problems or driving bold innovations, your growth is our success, and together, we’ll create the conversations of tomorrow.

Empower your impact at Cision. Be seen, be understood, be you.

Staff Software Engineer – DevX

We're looking for an accomplished Staff Software Engineer (DevX) to drive the development of tools and platforms that enhance our developers’ experience. In this role, you'll build and integrate software solutions that streamline coding, testing, and deployment processes, making our engineering teams more effective and efficient. You will collaborate closely with other engineers to identify workflow bottlenecks and implement innovative solutions, acting as a technical leader in shaping our internal development ecosystem. Reporting to the DevX Manager (Observability & DevX), you'll also mentor other engineers and uphold best practices in code quality, automation, and performance.

What You’ll Do

Design and develop internal software tools, services, and frameworks that improve the developer experience (e.g. custom CLI tools, development environment enhancements, test automation frameworks).
Work with engineering teams to gather requirements and feedback for developer tools, then iterate on solutions to ensure they address real-world needs.
Improve and maintain our CI/CD pipeline code and infrastructure, ensuring build and deployment processes are efficient, reliable, and scalable.
Contribute to the architecture of our developer platform by evaluating new technologies and integrating open-source solutions to enhance productivity.
Mentor and guide other software engineers in using DevX tools and adopting best practices for efficient software delivery.
Ensure all DevX solutions are well-documented, maintainable, and secure; actively participate in code reviews and design discussions to uphold high standards.
Partner with engineering teams to define and enforce AI standards within the developer ecosystem, ensuring consistent, scalable, and secure adoption of AI-driven solutions.

Essential Skills & Experience

7–10 years' experience in Software Engineering or DevOps roles, with a focus on building developer tooling or platforms.
Expert programming skills in one or more languages (such as Python, Java, Go, or C#), with the ability to write clean, maintainable code for internal tools and services.
Experience designing and implementing CI/CD pipelines and build/release processes, including familiarity with tools like Jenkins, GitLab CI, or GitHub Actions.
Solid understanding of software development best practices (version control, code reviews, automated testing) and experience integrating these into automated workflows.
Proficiency with containerization and cloud infrastructure (Docker, Kubernetes, AWS/GCP) to support on-demand development and testing environments.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to quickly learn and adapt to new technologies and frameworks that improve developer productivity.
Excellent communication skills and a collaborative approach, with experience mentoring engineers or leading technical projects to successful outcomes.

Preferred (Not Essential)

Contributions to open-source developer tools or active involvement in the developer community.
Experience with developer experience platforms or tools (e.g. Backstage, Atlassian suite) is a plus.

If you're a “developer’s developer” who loves creating tools that make engineering teams happier and more productive, we'd love to have you on board. Apply today and help us build a top-notch development ecosystem at Cision!

Please note that this position is only available to candidates who are currently residing in Bulgaria. Unfortunately, we are unable to consider applicants outside of the country.

As a global leader in PR, marketing and social media management technology and intelligence, Cision helps brands and organizations around the world connect with customers and stakeholders to drive results. By leveraging PR Newswire’s vast influencer network, comprehensive monitoring and analytics, and our Brandwatch and Falcon.io social platforms, we offer an unparalleled suite of solutions for modern communicators. Cision’s team operates in 24 countries across the Americas, EMEA, and APAC. Discover more at cision.com
and follow @Cision on Twitter.

Cision is the global leader in consumer and media intelligence, engagement, and communication solutions. We equip PR and corporate communications, marketing, and social media professionals with the tools they need to excel in today's data driven world. Our deep expertise, exclusive data partnerships, and award-winning products, including CisionOne
, Brandwatch
, and PR Newswire
, enable over 75,000 companies and organizations, including 84% of the Fortune 500, to see and be seen, understand and be understood by the audiences that matter most to them.

Cision is committed to fostering an inclusive environment where all employees can be their authentic selves and perform at their best. jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Description

Build the technology that powers everyday banking and creates lasting value for customers and the business. Join Customer Capabilities, a tribe of around 130 colleagues organised into 13 cross-functional teams across Denmark, Lithuania, and India. Together, we deliver effective end-to-end solutions for Danske Bank’s customers and employees across four business-critical domains: Fees, Interest, Tax Reporting, and Customer Communication.

Our platform supports essential banking products and digital banking experiences at scale, processing high transaction volumes every day. You will build sustainable, resilient software guided by clean design, measurable performance, operational excellence, and a clear focus on customer needs.

As part of our engineering community, you will collaborate across the tribe, influence technical direction, establish consistent engineering standards, and help evolve our solutions to deliver reliable customer experiences and measurable business outcomes.

The role is based in Vilnius and follows Danske Bank’s hybrid working model, with the flexibility to work from home one to two days per week.

Please note that relocation support is not available for this role.

You will:

Develop reliable systems that support everyday banking products and customer-facing services.
Shape the design and architecture of resilient, high-quality software solutions.
Apply robust engineering and security practices to cloud-native applications.
Collaborate with product owners, business analysts, UX designers, and engineers to turn business needs into seamless end-to-end solutions.
Contribute to digital transformation initiatives and deliver complex projects with tangible impact.
Strengthen an agile and supportive culture built on collaboration, continuous learning, and respect for different perspectives.
Apply agentic AI capabilities where they can improve outcomes, efficiency, or service quality.

About you:

A bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field; AWS or similar certifications beneficial.
A proactive and curious mindset, with a strong sense of ownership, a commitment to continuous improvement, and a structured approach to exploring and solving problems.
Relevant software engineering experience, with deep hands-on expertise in React Native- or a strong React.js background and the ability to transition effectively to React Native. You bring sound architectural judgement and mastery of modern React patterns, including Hooks, Context API, and Redux, together with component-driven UI architecture and navigation or routing.
Expertise in .NET or Java, together with hands-on knowledge of microservices and container-based development using OpenShift, Kubernetes, or Amazon EKS.
Familiarity with DevSecOps practices, Git and GitHub, logging and monitoring, and cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure.
An understanding of customer-first principles and exposure to customer-facing products would be an advantage.
Strong collaboration and communication skills, with advanced proficiency in English.

We offer:

Monthly salary range from 4960 EUR to 7440 EUR gross (based on your competencies relevant for the job).

Additionally, each Danske Bank employee receives employee benefits package which includes:

Growth opportunities: professional & supportive team, e-learnings, numerous development programs; (incl. professional certificates); 100+ professions for internal mobility opportunities.
Health & Well-being: a diverse, inclusive, work & life balance work environment; additional health insurance; mental well-being practices; partial psychologist counselling compensation; silence and sleep zones at the office; game rooms.
Hybrid working conditions: Work from home up to two days a week; home office budget (after the probation period); modern Danske Campus workplace developed with anthropologist for the best employee experience.
Additional days of leave: for rest, health, volunteering, exams in higher education institutions, and other important activities. Moreover, for seniority with Danske Bank.
Monetary compensation package: accidents & critical diseases insurance; financial support in case of unfortunate events, travel insurance; IIIrd Pillar Pension Fund contribution.

See all the benefits HERE
.

Your job function (position) in the job contract will be Software Engineering.

Please apply as soon as possible, as we review candidates and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis. If you have questions, please reach out to Elvis Ramovic
(elra@danskebank.dk, mobile +45 30531926) or contact me via LinkedIn.

About Us

Danske Bank is a Nordic bank with bridges to the world around us. For 150 years, we have supported people and businesses in releasing their potential. A career with us is an opportunity to join a community of 22,000 colleagues in a culture where we are committed to Teaming Up, Owning It and Being Open. Together, we are on a journey to transform Danske Bank into a better bank. For our customers, our employees and the societies around us.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Quality (Web)
jobs.description:
At Unity, our QA team members are the test and quality experts for feature areas. We are fully embedded and rely on communication and collaboration to help the whole team deliver quality software. We are responsible for fostering a culture of quality and facilitating the idea of challenging quality issues across the entire team.

You'll be embedded and working closely with developers for the Web Platform team. In addition to working as part of your development team, you will be part of a global Platform QA team that actively works to ensure the functionality, stability, and usability across all of Unity’s platforms.

In this role, you will engage with QA, producers, and development on test strategies and approaches for a variety of projects. You will help the team find the right balance of automated and manual testing, and contribute to the tools and processes that continually improve quality across the team. We expect you to be hands-on and empowered to dive in and solve technical testing challenges as needed.

We believe testing is a craft that requires training and skill. We invest in our employees and expect you to invest in your own professional growth. Our employees love to learn, and challenge themselves as well as each other to grow.

What You’ll Be Doing

Independently develop and maintain the test approach for your designated areas, balancing manual and automated coverage with your developers
Prioritise and adjust your testing as the work evolves, directing effort where it has the most effect
Review pull requests and technical designs to identify coverage gaps and surface risks early
Identify the quality information your team needs to make decisions and report on it regularly
Plan and estimate your own work, committing to what you can deliver and renegotiating scope when capacity is exceeded
Contribute to quality improvements in your team and help see them through to adoption
Coach developers on testing practice and give feedback they can act on
Build working relationships across development, product and other partner functions, taking the initiative in bringing QA into their work early

What We’re Looking For

Solid grounding in QA principles and methodologies, and the judgement to apply them without close supervision
Programming experience with C#, strong enough to review developers’ code changes and maintain automated tests
Experience deriving a test approach for complex functionality from requirements and technical design
Experience raising quality standards within a team, including coaching engineers who don’t report to you
Able to justify your estimates and hold to them when priorities shift
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the early escalation of risk

You might also have

Experience with testing WebAssembly applications in browser environments
Working knowledge of the Unity Editor and building Unity projects
Programming experience with JavaScript
Experience with CI/CD pipelines and maintaining automated test suites within them
Scrum certification or experience working in a Scrum team

Base Salary Range: We determine the base salary range for this role based on your primary work location:

Zone A: €41,800 - €52,200 EUR gross

This range reflects the anticipated base salary for this position. Beyond base salary, this role may be eligible for equity awards and participation in our company incentive plans (such as annual discretionary bonuses or sales commissions). The final offer amount will depend on several factors, including geographic location and the candidate’s relevant experience, professional background, and skill set.

Benefits

At Unity, we want our team members to thrive. We offer a wide range of benefits designed to support well-being and work-life balance.

Please note: Benefits eligibility, specific offerings, and coverage vary based on the country and employment status.

While specific benefits vary, here are some of the ways we strive to take care of our eligible team members globally: Comprehensive health, life, and disability insurance | Commute subsidy | Employee stock ownership | Competitive retirement/pension plans | Generous vacation and personal days | Support for new parents through leave and family-care programs | Office food snacks | Mental Health and Wellbeing programs and support | Employee Resource Groups | Global Employee Assistance Program | Training and development programs | Volunteering and donation matching program

Life at Unity

Unity [NYSE: U] is the world’s leading game engine, powering play for more than 3 billion consumers each month. The top mobile games in the world, the most played PC indie titles, the most innovative console games, and virtually all of the top XR and Web Games are developed, deployed, and grown in Unity. Unity also enables teams across industries like automotive, manufacturing, and healthcare to design, simulate, and collaborate in 3D — closing the gap between ideas and reality. For more information, please visit www.unity.com.

Unity is a proud equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment and celebrate our employees across age, race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or any other protected status in accordance with applicable law. Our differences are strengths that enable us to support the growing and evolving needs of our customers, partners, and collaborators.
